verdict.rationale: Anrok is an API-first tax SaaS, so llms.txt or agent-oriented docs is a fair question for it. A direct probe found no llms.txt (HTTP 404 at apidocs.anrok.com/llms.txt), and no evidence shows docs written for agents. The openapi.yaml spec and the 'hand it to your agents' marketing line are adjacent at best: a machine-readable API spec and a product pitch, not llms.txt or agent-oriented documentation.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs
